title: Tele System TS ON T2/HD (ONT2HD), Android TV 11 (SDK 30), firmware 20231013:user/release-keys
header:
Tele System TS ON T2/HD (ONT2HD), Android TV 11 (SDK 30), firmware 20231013:user/release-keys
SDMC ODM platform with Amlogic/droidlogic SoC, Italy/Europe DVB-T2 set-top box / TV.

Live TV app: com.sdmc.tv (owns the digital tuner and leanback activity; set as live_tv_package).
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (classic Android TV home, disabled by launcher/build-and-install.sh).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/telesystem-ont2hd/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/telesystem-ont2hd/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Notes on this device:
- Connect over ADB: port 5555 is open when USB debugging is enabled in Developer Options.
- The replacement launcher from launcher/ installs cleanly and takes Home without issues.
- Live TV: com.sdmc.tv runs tuner playback and provides leanback launcher activity.
- DO NOT DISABLE:
com.sdmc.tv                  Live TV tuner app
com.droidlogic.tvinput       HDMI and tuner input framework
com.sdmc.bluetoothconnect    Bluetooth remote pairing
com.sdmc.GlobalKey           Remote control hotkey handler
com.droidlogic.updater       Firmware OTA updates

apps.note: SDMC partner customer service (purpose unclear; comment out if anything breaks)

optional.note: Stock launcher: the installer disables it once the new Home is in
